Date: Oct 22, 2026 | Location: HQ 2nd floor boardroom
Present: E. Lambright (Chair), G. Rohde, V. Wang, D. Swan, N. Ahmed (CFO), M. Kelly (counsel, by invitation)

Item 3: Q3 Financial Review (N. Ahmed)
- Q3 net loss approx. $14.8M (prelim., unaudited) vs. budget loss of $2.1M. Occupancy roughly 71%, down from 84% YoY.
- Leverage covenant (max 4.25x) appears to have been exceeded at ~4.61x as of Sept 30, pending final compliance certificate.
- Interest coverage ~1.9x vs. 2.25x minimum; CFO to confirm calculation.
- Waiver request to Harbor Trust Bank not yet agreed. Possible cross-default to Meridian mezzanine facility if not cured or waived by Dec 31 (counsel to confirm terms).
- Possible scenarios discussed: acceleration of $212M term loan; forbearance (fee figure of 2.5% mentioned, not confirmed).
- Board discussed restructuring: possible exit of some underperforming sites (number discussed, 12, not final), sale-leaseback option. Chair requested restructuring committee proposal by Dec 5.

Item 5: Harmon St. lease renewal deferred pending restructuring review.
